actions.reason: Replace functools.lru_cache on the three private alphabet-table helpers with a small module-local memoiser (dict keyed by the positional argument tuple, cleared once it holds 128 entries, so it stays bounded like lru_cache(maxsize=128)). Importing base58 no longer imports functools, which also pulls in collections, reprlib, keyword, operator and types at startup. Internal callers now pass autofix positionally, so the cache key is a plain tuple. Public API, return values and cached object identity are unchanged; tests pass and the equivalence harness reports identical outputs. Measured: check_ir 0.957, encode_ir 0.970, decode_ir 0.972 relative to parent.
